augmented_rectangular_ls_certificate.primary_kkt_backward_error_policy: reported for transparency only; BFGS is gated by independently recomputed raw gradient, objective gap, coefficient, and metric agreement
augmented_rectangular_ls_certificate.solver: Eigen SparseQR on rectangular A with COLAMD ordering

normalization.I_0: q=4 GL4 raw/sqrt(length) fit-time balance MSE at frozen checkpoint
normalization.J_0: original weighted data+PDE+IC+BC objective at frozen checkpoint

normalization_probe.purpose: evaluate J_0 and I_0 at the exact frozen control vector without optimization

optimizer.rationale: A relative scale term is retained while a 1e-10 absolute floor avoids the sealed V1 1e-12 L-BFGS step-stagnation artifact; the floor is two orders tighter than the V1 primary campaign.

selector.knee_rule: maximum signed endpoint-chord distance oriented toward ideal (0,0); if no interior point lies toward ideal, minimum ideal distance
